body: REDGARDEN commit 1aac71c. Ring buffer of action timestamps (clicks + Q/W/E casts) in apps/arena/src/main.c; apm_compute() counts entries in a trailing 60s window. Off by default, F11 toggles it in any mode. Verified via build_arena.sh, test_arena.sh, and a local mingw cross-compile, all clean. Closes BACKLOG S170-71.
title: Toggleable APM overlay, F11
